title: Top Selling Product per Year
scenario: Find the product with the highest total quantity sold in each year. Return 'year', 'product_id', and 'total_quantity'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Rank products by SUM(quantity) partitioned by year.
correctQuery: SELECT year, product_id, total_quantity FROM (SELECT year, product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY year ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC) AS rnk FROM sales GROUP BY year, product_id) t WHERE rnk = 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 5000), (2, 200, 2008, 20, 5000);
